prohibited_uses: reuse of ephemeral CI gate keys as release keys
committing private keys or passphrases to the repository
publishing signed artifacts before a named release owner and key custodian approve the release identity
treating signature plumbing as security review or R1 evidence
custody_decision_required: select an external protected key store or hardware-backed signing service
define least-privilege signer access and audit retention
define offline recovery, rotation, and revocation handling
publish the trusted public-key fingerprint through an independently controlled channel
evidence_boundary: The existing ephemeral CI key proves only gate plumbing and tamper detection; an ephemeral CI key is not a release identity. No release private key, custodian, protected signer, recovery procedure, revocation procedure, or trusted public-key publication channel has been established, so signed publication is blocked and R1 remains blocked.
